summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly report on New Residential Construction for August 2022, released September 20, 2022. It provides the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) figures for total housing starts and completions required to calculate 'net inventory change' for the task's starting month (2022/08) and the preceding month (2022/07). Key data points include August 2022 Starts (1,575,000) and Completions (1,342,000), marked preliminary, alongside revised July 2022 figures (Starts: 1,404,000; Completions: 1,419,000) needed to assess whether the preceding month had a negative change. As the initial report for this period, it supplies baseline values that may be subject to revision in later releases per the task's precedence rules.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on new residential construction for September 2022 (released October 19, 2022). It provides the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) figures for total housing starts and total housing completions required to calculate the 'net inventory change' for the relevant months in the task's 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe. Specific data points include September 2022 (Starts: 1,439,000; Completions: 1,427,000) and revised August 2022 figures (Starts: 1,566,000; Completions: 1,345,000). These values enable the computation of net inventory change for September and the assessment of the preceding month's (August) status. The data is marked as preliminary (September) or revised (August), indicating potential for updates in later releases where the most recent report would prevail under task rules.

Specific figures include October 2022 (Starts: 1,425,000; Completions: 1,339,000), revised September 2022 (Starts: 1,488,000; Completions: 1,431,000), and revised August 2022 (Starts: 1,508,000; Completions: 1,352,000). These data points enable the calculation of the 'net inventory change' for these months and allow for the verification of the 'preceded by a month with a negative change' condition for September and October. Note that later releases in the collection (such as the December 2022 report noted in other summaries) may contain updated values for these months which would take precedence per the task's conflict resolution rule.
